set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Execution: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Work key: O03.8
Accountable role (person unassigned): Recovery/backend engineer
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Qualify the earlier current-capability recovery milestone before browser workspace expansion. O03.5 repeats and extends this rehearsal after identity/session integration; this task cannot close H03, O03 or H00.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O03 (bd-01M4W40KBWB13MJQHFAGJEGYZR)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Using a packaged organization-enabled build, create two labs, projects, independent and release-scoped shares and retained releases; back up through H03.1. After backup revoke a share, remove a membership, disable a principal, atomically transfer stewardship and revoke a credential; capture verified durable acknowledgments and independent expected access results.
2. Destroy or isolate only the disposable original service, catalog and blob namespace. Restore onto fresh targets using separately controlled backup/policy services, without original source mounts, credentials, connections or import sources; retain configuration/network evidence of that isolation.
3. After recovery, retained release/interpretation identities, exact bytes/export hashes and historical attribution match the predeclared oracle. Revoked/expired shares, removed membership, disabled principals, former steward authority and every old token/lease remain unusable. Freshly admitted authorized users and the new steward can perform their legitimate scoped actions; a permanently closed service cannot count as success.
4. Exercise metadata/content/receipt access, fixed-release boundaries, newly admitted delivery chunks and pending work reacquisition using the F03.3/F03.4 checks. Add restrictive events for targets missing from the older backup and prove their denial survives replay.
5. Repeat with stale/truncated/tampered or unavailable witness evidence, corrupt/missing blobs, unresolved PREPARE, a live stale writer and interruptions around barrier release/reopening. Each unsafe case stays closed; retry cannot restore revoked access or duplicate completed recovery effects.
6. Retain exact source/artifact/configuration/fixture identities, commands, raw results, recovery receipts and measured catalog/API versus full-byte recovery times and observed scientific-data loss. Record zero lost acknowledged restrictions. State the same-computer physical failure-domain limit and list unqualified identity/session/lifecycle capabilities; off-host qualification remains O03.3/Q03.1.

Verification: Repeatable executable backup-change-isolate-restore rehearsal with independent positive/negative authorization oracles, exact scientific hashes and real timing; all negative cases observed, not inferred from unit tests.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.8/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- docs/decisions/004-policy-durability.md
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresOrganizationCatalog.scala
- modules/service/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/RecoveryCli.scala
- scripts/backup-postgres.sh
- scripts/restore-postgres.sh

Blocked by:
- O03.7: bd-01M4XPDDP01BGZJJ73Z32TFCC1
- F02.3: bd-01M4W5P591G5D5048MSJ46BN27
- F03.3: bd-01M4W5P5MCD12DVHWQC1KFXNDP
- F03.4: bd-01M4W5P5RX4RKKKDM2NSCV30RY

User-approved recovery priority, 14 October 2026. Current-capability recovery precedes browser expansion; full identity/session/lifecycle and institutional qualification remain mandatory.

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; no institutional or physical-failure qualification from same-host fixtures. Planning closes no implementation work.
set.title: O03.8: Prove current-catalog recovery after source isolation
